choice: Reuse a decoded-history decision across batch representations only with an actual proof covering the entire resulting ordered history, or a separately proved predicate-preservation theorem. Do not inherit arbitrary old evidence merely because the storage extension preserves old slots.
premises: The Certificate supplies an actual proof of its predicate on its complete entries.
For the sequential/combined consumers, certificate.entries equals oldRows ++ (first ++ second); actual proved codecs reconstruct that list.
Valid original references are required for the general same-predicate batch equivalence.
checked_counterexample: The empty-history length-zero predicate is true before append and false after successful one-row append; no automatic semantic evidence inheritance.
application: Agent coordination records distinguish stored reasons and old proofs from evidence for the current full premises. Exact path/hash/source occurrences and verification states stay separate from semantic decoding.
separate_open_obligations: Typed relation correspondence, embedding hypotheses and 215 unprovided method identities.
contribution: Human direction grwtsk contributors; OpenAI Codex formalization/checking and correlated review; upstream Lean/Mathlib preserved.
authority: Durable local decision policy within existing user authorization; no remote effect, new axiom, independent validation or broader theorem admission.
